title: Frontend build: esbuild config, chunk naming, index.html generation
answers: How is the PostHog frontend built?
Where are chunk names and hashes configured?
How does dist/index.html get its hashed entry script?
body:
- frontend/build.mjs: `buildInParallel([...])` runs PostHog App (src/index.tsx + sharedChunkAnchors, splitting, ESM), WORKER_ENTRIES, Exporter, Render Query (IIFE), Toolbar. `onBuildComplete` for App: `reportTopChunks`, `writePreloadManifest` (prod), then `writeIndexHtml(chunks, entrypoints)`; every build ends with `createHashlessEntrypoints`.
- `writeIndexHtml` → `copyIndexHtml` twice: src/index.html→dist/index.html and src/layout.html→dist/layout.html; exporter→dist/exporter.html, render query→dist/render_query.html.
- common/esbuilder/utils.mjs:`commonConfig`: `entryNames` = dev `[dir]/[name]`, prod `[dir]/[name]-[hash]`; `chunkNames` `[name]-[hash]` (→ chunk-HASH.js); `assetNames` `assets/[name]-[hash]`; `publicPath` '/static'; `metafile: true`.
- `getChunks(result)` reads metafile static imports per entry, keyed by first export (or `index` for root entries); `getBuiltEntryPoints` pairs entry JS with CSS by name+single hash.
- `createHashlessEntrypoints` copies index-HASH.js → index.js as fallback.
- `copyIndexHtml` injects inline nonce'd script before </head>: ESBUILD_LOAD_SCRIPT (import JS_URL+/static/+file, fallback to unhashed index.js?t=buildId), `cssLoaderScript` (cssLoader.mjs), `chunkLoaderScript` (chunkLoader.mjs; omitted in dev: `chunksToServe = isDev ? {} : chunks`).
